English.Char_Desc_45: Dock corner stock and crypto ticker for Mac
English.Char_Desc_80: Minimalist financial ticker living in the empty corner beside the macOS Dock.
English.Char_Desc_250: Tape dynamically calculates macOS Dock geometry, sits flush in the dead corner beside it, and cycles through your stock/crypto watchlist in the official brand colors of each company.
English.Char_Desc_2000: Tape is a minimal, distraction-free stock and cryptocurrency ticker for macOS. Rather than filling your menu bar or keeping heavy browser dashboards running, Tape uses the empty corner space beside your Dock. It smoothly cycles through your portfolio items with custom brand coloring and daily trend charts. 100% native Swift, open source under MIT.
